business_summary: Toyo Denki Seizo K.K., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells electrical machinery and equipment for transportation, industrial, ICT solutions, and related businesses in Japan and internationally. It operates through Transportation Business, Industrial Business, and ICT Solutions Business. The Transportation Business segment manufactures and sells electrical equipment for railway vehicles, new transit system vehicles, special vehicles, and power storage devices for railways. Its Industrial Business segment is involved in the manufacturing, production, and processing of equipment drive systems, automotive testing systems, power generation and infrastructure systems, and in-vehicle electrical components. The ICT Solutions Business segment manufactures and sells station equipment systems; and OT solutions including cloud-based remote monitoring and control systems. It also engages in related construction work. The company was incorporated in 1918 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.
